message.content:
Checked: the read replica is 12 minutes behind. The primary shows 1204 failed jobs, with 47 malformed rows. Exported the failed_jobs table.

Next steps: Investigate why jobs are failing and fix the root cause. Backfill the failed jobs as resources allow.

arguments.summary: Investigated the failed-jobs backlog and identified 1204 failed jobs, 47 of which were malformed. The backlog will be addressed by investigating and fixing the root cause of job failures, and backfilling the failed jobs as resources allow.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate and fix root cause of job failures, backfill failed jobs.
